wins.label: Q1 beat on revenue and margins
wins.evidence: Q1 revenue was $12.7 billion, coming in at the high end of our guidance range...Non-GAAP gross margin was 39.2%, approximately 3 percentage points above our guidance

wins.label: New leadership driving organizational simplification
wins.evidence: I have flattened the structure of my leadership team, all critical product, manufacturing and G&A functions...are now directly reporting to me

wins.label: OpEx and CapEx reduction targets
wins.evidence: We now expect OpEx of $17 billion this year and $16 billion next year...taking our target for this year to $18 billion [CapEx]

wins.label: Panther Lake product on track with 18A
wins.evidence: We have a good foundation...we have the first SKU by the end of this year, then we have additional SKU in the next year

wins.label: Altera monetization via Silver Lake partnership
wins.evidence: we announced on April 14, our intention to sell 51% of Altera to Silver Lake Partners for an almost $9 billion valuation with Intel receiving net cash proceeds of $4.4 billion

risks.label: Macro uncertainty and tariff headwinds
risks.evidence: the economic landscape has become increasingly uncertain driven by shifting trade policies, persistent inflation and increased regulatory risk...the probability of a recession growing

risks.label: Q2 guidance significantly weakened
risks.evidence: we're forecasting a wider-than-normal Q2 revenue range of $11.2 billion to $12.4 billion, down 2% to 12% sequentially

risks.label: Gross margin pressure from product mix and 18A ramp
risks.evidence: Lunar Lake's margins are more under pressure given the memories and package...there are start-up costs associated with that, bringing that up in Arizona

risks.label: Intel 7 capacity constraints persist
risks.evidence: capacity constraints in Intel 7, which we expect to persist for the foreseeable future

risks.label: Foundry business requires significant trust-building
risks.evidence: success in foundry business requires more than process technology, manufacturing capabilities alone...we need to instill customer service mindset across our foundry business
